# Grid-Based Logic Games Taxonomy

## 1. Number Placement & Constraint Games
*Games where digits/numbers must be placed according to numeric rules*
- Sudoku
- Ripple Effect
- Makaro
- Nansuke
- Juosan

## 2. Region Division & Partitioning Games
*Games where the grid must be divided into defined regions or shapes*
- Fillomino
- Shikaku
- Five Cells
- Double Choco
- Evolomino
- Nuritwin
- Choco Banana

## 3. Path & Loop Drawing Games
*Games where continuous paths, loops, or lines must be drawn through the grid*
- Slitherlink
- Masyu
- Numberlink
- Hebi
- Nagareru
- Suraromu
- Mid-loop
- Moon-or-Sun
- Dotchi-Loop
- Pencils

## 4. Area Shading & Painting Games
*Games where cells must be shaded or colored according to specific rules*
- Nurikabe
- Hitori
- Heyawake
- Kurodoko
- Tilepaint
- Nurimeizu
- Norinori
- LITS
- Usowan
- Yajilin
- Kurotto

## 5. Light & Visibility Games
*Games governed by line-of-sight, illumination, or directional visibility rules*
- Akari
- Shakashaka
- Nurimisaki

## 6. Object Placement & Movement Games
*Games where objects are placed, moved, or gravitate according to positional rules*
- Yosenabe
- Satogaeri
- Sto-stone
- Chained Block
- Sashigane

## 7. Bridge & Connection Games
*Games where nodes or cells must be connected via bridges or links*
- Hashiwokakero
